verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot's cloud agent (Copilot coding agent) can be assigned tasks to autonomously plan, code, and execute in isolated sandboxes, with PR review and a control plane to track progress, closely matching the build/test/review workflow. However, evidence lacks explicit mention of automated 'demo' generation, and community commentary raises concerns about code quality, reliability, and trustworthiness of AI-driven fixes/PRs, suggesting the experience is not fully mature or dispute-free.
